Yes. I plan to stay for quite a while this time,
so I'm stocking up on the facial masks I normally use.

Cosmetics work best when you stick to what your skin is used to,
after all. I really don't want to run out while I'm over there.

Eh, ah, no...... But... you're right.
Maybe I should take notes. ...Fufu, thank you, as always!

Yes. Of course.
Because in Hong Kong... umm.........

Having you here was a huge help, Trainer.
Well then, shall we head back?
Yet surely, more than that—

If I buy enough for our business partners too, it'll be a massive haul.
I definitely wouldn't have enough hands on my own.
Hmm. A Japanese confectionery gift set! I had no idea they had something like this.

(Well, the general premise isn't entirely wrong...
I'll tell them about coming along later... definitely later!)
Zan hai?! You went out of your way to look it up? That helps so much!
"Why did you go and make all these plans without asking me in the first place...?"

This looks gorgeous and has such a traditional Japanese feel!
I'm sure my parents will love it. Thank you♪
(You're coming with me, you know.)
(...I've endured far worse when business negotiations broke down, so why...)

Hong Kong... She must be visiting home. Seeing her shopping,
perhaps she's looking for advice on Japanese souvenirs...

Hong Kong has plenty of Western pastries... so if possible,
something distinctly Japanese would be ideal~.

Th-Thank you... That's right! First, I'd like
to buy souvenirs for Mom and Dad. I'd love your advice!

(Why can't I just say it?!
All I have to say is, "You're coming with me"?!)
"Why did you go and make all these plans without asking me first...?"

(...Huh? ...Why can't I say it?
Just tell them: "You're going to Hong Kong too"—)
......Fufu. Right, since we have the chance, after all♪

Let's see... clothes...? 
No, but—
!? A notepad? What's this for...?
"Together?! I'd love to go, but... springing it on me out of nowhere makes it... tough."
(To think just imagining it would hit me even harder...)

If she's stocking up, it's bound to be a heavy load!
I ought to lend a hand here.
No... it's nothing...

(If I'm going to ask, I need to create a situation
where I can draw out Trainer's true thoughts more effectively...!)

Trainer! Perfect timing!
What are your plans for today?
(All right... I'll pull through this with the ultimate strategy!)
Could this be... a potential business opportunity...?

Ahaha! I'm not buying that much.
Though... could I ask you to carry the souvenirs?
True... that might be part of it.

Ah, I'm sorry to keep you waiting.
And thanks for the notepad. It really came in handy!
Ah... no, in Hong Kong—

When she's thinking this hard, it means she's deep in thought about business.
All I can really do at times like this is hand her a notepad.
(Ah... I'm just afraid... of being rejected.)
On a day off, I ran into Satono Crown in front of the station.

Oh! In that case, would you mind keeping me company for some shopping?
I have preparations to make for my trip to Hong Kong. And I'd love to hear your thoughts!

Hmm, which one should I pick?
There are so many things that would make great souvenirs, but...

If it's a souvenir for her parents living in Hong Kong, something traditional Japanese might be best.
Deciding on that approach, I chose to look into it.

Phew, that should about do it.
Sorry for making you carry all the bags.
...Considering how long we'll be staying... maybe we need about three...?
...OK. Once I put this all together and show it to Father...!

...I feel like there isn't much variety in men's fashion in Japan.
Not that that's necessarily a bad thing, of course...
Hao! This is getting... rather interesting!
Ngh...

Come, let's head to Hong Kong together!
I've already got our schedule over there completely sorted out!
(Asking her like this won't work, huh...)
We've got a lot of bags, so why don't we take a short break?

Haaa... It's just a trip back home to Hong Kong,
and yet I'm feeling quite nervous, aren't I...
